# OmniHand SDK

Vendor Python package and shared libraries copied from the verified
`dexhit_collection` runtime. It is Python 3.12 / Linux x86_64 only.

`third_party/env.sh` adds this directory and its native libraries to
`PYTHONPATH` / `LD_LIBRARY_PATH`. The vendor license is governed by the
original OmniHand/Agilink distribution; keep this directory with the project
only when that distribution is authorized.
